theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hOr : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_cases hA : A ∈ P
    · exact Or.inl hA
    · have hA' : ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        apply hPS
        exact ⟨A, hA, h⟩
      rcases hA' with ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩
      have hA''' : ∀ V ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ V ≠ ∅ := by
        intro V hV
        have hUV : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
        have hUV' : U ∩ V ⊆ Aᶜ ∩ V := by
          intro x hx
          rcases hx with ⟨hUx, hVx⟩
          exact ⟨by rwa [hAU] at hUx, hVx⟩
        rcases hUV with ⟨x, hx⟩
        exact Set.Nonempty.mpr ⟨x, hUV' hx⟩
      by_contra hAᶜ_not
      apply hPS
      exact ⟨Aᶜ, hAᶜ_not, hA'''⟩
  have hNot : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hA'
    have := hPP A hA Aᶜ hA'
    simpa [Set.inter_compl] using this
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have hQ : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A => Aᶜ) (fun A => Aᶜ)
    · intro A hA
      exact hNot A hA
    · intro A hA
      have hA_or := hOr A
      cases hA_or with
      | inl hA => contradiction
      | inr hA' => exact hA'
    · intro A hA
      simp_all [compl_compl]
    · intro A hA
      simp_all [compl_compl]
  have hC : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P Q]
    simp [Q, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set, Finset.diff_self]
  rw [hQ] at hC
  omega
